bg.$description: color used by the list component for background.

padding.$description: dimension used by the list component for padding.

gap.$description: dimension used by the list component for gap (MarsUI compositions stack rows contiguously; --ki-list-gap stays as the theme hook).

min-height.$description: dimension used by the list component for item min height (MarsUI md text-only row is ~40px content-sized: 20px line + 2x10 padding).

min-height-multiline.$description: dimension used by the list component for multiline item min height (MarsUI md two-line row measures 56px).

padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the list component for item padding inline.

padding-block.$description: dimension used by the list component for item padding block (MarsUI md rows: Space/lg 10px).

gap.$description: dimension used by the list component for item gap (MarsUI md/lg rows: Space/xl 12px between start/content/end regions).

radius.$description: dimension used by the list component for item radius.

divider-width.$description: dimension used by the list component for item divider width (no divider renders in any master variant; the color hook ki.list.item.divider-color stays so consumers can opt hairlines back in).

divider-color.$description: color used by the list component for item divider color.

primary-font-size.$description: dimension used by the list component for item primary font size.

primary-line-height.$description: dimension used by the list component for primary line height (MarsUI primary is UI/Para/medium 13/20, not UI/Body 1 13/24).

primary-font-weight.$description: font weight used by the list component for item primary font weight.

primary-fg.$description: color used by the list component for item primary foreground.

secondary-font-size.$description: dimension used by the list component for secondary font size (MarsUI description line is UI/Caption 2: 12px).

secondary-line-height.$description: dimension used by the list component for secondary line height (MarsUI caption_2 16px; same value as before with the correct provenance).

secondary-font-weight.$description: font weight used by the list component for item secondary font weight.

secondary-fg.$description: color used by the list component for item secondary foreground.
